method: Rendered page images were inspected manually. The rendered page, not pdftotext, determines whether a textual source block is present, its boundaries, and whether it continues on the next page. Text extraction was used only to transcribe and cross-check tokens. Whitespace is normalized where PDF line wrapping is imposed by a narrow table column; SysML tokens and existing // comments are preserved.

ambiguities: Clause boundaries share physical pages: 7.13/7.14 both occur on physical 106, and 7.14/7.15 both occur on physical 110.
The owned-cross-feature example S713-12 starts at the bottom of physical 101 and closes on physical 102; it is recorded as one entry with both pages.
The succession shorthand example S713-25 starts on physical 105 and continues on physical 106; the page-spanning // equivalence comment is retained.

Several representative-notation rows omit the owning definition or use `/* members */`/`/* ... */`; these are marked complete_template and contextual_fragment rather than treated as semantic-clean fixtures.
The Table 10 directed-feature type is printed as `AttrributeDef3` (three r characters); the transcription intentionally preserves the PDF token.
